description: "We are Orion X, a passionate team of high school freshmen driven by an endless curiosity for learning and knowledge. Named after the mighty Orion constellation, we are taking on the Storytelling challenge to give a voice to the silent objects left behind in space—turning the history of forgotten spacecraft and cosmic debris into compelling stories that connect humanity to the cosmos for the NASA Space Apps Challenge."

details:
Abandoned But Not Forgotten" is an interactive web platform designed for the digital generation. It transforms scattered and complicated NASA space archives into a fast, engaging, and easy-to-navigate digital experience. It features a live Apollo 11 countdown, real archival launch videos, and an interactive mission timeline that brings space history directly to students.

Intended Impact & Benefits:

It solves the problem of student disengagement and the confusion of traditional, boring research methods. By bridging the gap between historical space data and modern youth, it makes learning about space fun, accessible, and unforgettable.

Tools & Technologies:

We used modern web development tools and coding languages to build a clean, professional, and responsive platform with NASA Space Apps branding and a minimalist white theme.

Why our project is creative:

Our project is creative because we didn't just collect data—we reimagined how space history is told. Instead of boring text, we combined live countdowns, real archival footage, and interactive storytelling tailored specifically for today’s fast-paced digital era, making space exploration exciting for young minds.
